title: HIDE: Hierarchical Isolation via Documentation and Evidence for Rustc Bugs
title_zh: HIDE：基于文档与证据的 Rustc 缺陷层次化隔离

paragraphs.en: HIDE结合编译器文档与缺陷证据，层次化缩小候选范围，显著提升rustc缺陷隔离准确率。 Rustc bugs can prevent valid programs from compiling or cause incorrect compilation results, making the identification of responsible source files essential for repair. Using large language models (LLMs) for rustc bug isolation raises three challenges. First, distributed compiler functionality requires understanding both what individual files do and how they work together. Second, a large source file search space makes exhaustive analysis of all files costly. Third, including documentation and source code for many candidate files in LLM prompts leads to context overload, which can reduce bug isolation accuracy. We propose HIDE, a hierarchical LLM-based approach that combines compiler documentation with bug evidence to rank suspicious rustc source files. Given a rustc revision and a bug context, HIDE consists of two stages that generate compiler documentation and narrow the search space. To understand distributed compiler functionality, the Layered Documentation Aggregation stage summarizes what individual files do and how files with similar functions work together. To reduce the large source file search space, the Hierarchical Bug Isolation stage uses hierarchical candidate selection to reduce the number of files requiring detailed analysis. To mitigate context overload, this stage uses Scoped Candidate Competition and Evidence-Guided Code Slicing to limit the number of candidates and the amount of source code included in each prompt, respectively. We evaluate HIDE on 160 reproducible rustc bugs and compare it with Agentless, SoapFL, and GraphLocator. With GPT-5.4, HIDE achieves 42.08% Accuracy@1 and 80.42% Accuracy@10, exceeding the strongest baseline results by 5.83% and 6.04%, respectively. These results demonstrate that generating compiler documentation, narrowing candidates hierarchically, and limiting analysis context enable effective rustc bug isolation.
paragraphs.zh: rustc 缺陷会阻碍合法程序编译或导致错误的编译结果，因此定位导致问题的源文件对修复至关重要。HIDE 结合编译器文档与缺陷证据，层次化地缩小候选范围，显著提升了 rustc 缺陷隔离的准确率。 使用大语言模型（LLM）进行 rustc 缺陷隔离面临三个挑战。 第一，分布式的编译器功能既要求理解单个文件的功能，也要求理解这些文件如何协同工作。 第二，庞大的源文件搜索空间使得对所有文件进行穷尽式分析代价高昂。 第三，在 LLM 提示中包含大量候选文件的文档与源码会导致上下文过载，从而降低缺陷隔离的准确率。 我们提出 HIDE，这是一种基于 LLM 的层次化方法，它将编译器文档与缺陷证据相结合，对可疑的 rustc 源文件进行排序。 给定一个 rustc 版本和缺陷上下文，HIDE 由两个阶段组成，用于生成编译器文档并缩小搜索空间。 为了理解分布式的编译器功能，「分层文档聚合」阶段总结单个文件的功能，以及功能相近的文件如何协同工作。 为了缩减庞大的源文件搜索空间，「层次化缺陷隔离」阶段使用层次化候选选择来减少需要详细分析的文件数量。 为了缓解上下文过载，该阶段分别使用「范围化候选竞争」和「证据引导的代码切片」来限制每个提示中包含的候选数量和源代码数量。 我们在 160 个可复现的 rustc 缺陷上评估 HIDE，并将其与 Agentless、SoapFL 和 GraphLocator 进行比较。 使用 GPT-5.4 时，HIDE 取得了 42.08% 的 Accuracy@1 和 80.42% 的 Accuracy@10，分别超过最强基线 5.83% 和 6.04%。 这些结果表明，生成编译器文档、层次化缩小候选范围以及限制分析上下文，能够实现有效的 rustc 缺陷隔离。
